 Kerala Suvarna Keralam SK-73 Lottery Result Today LIVE on 16 October 2026: Check Winners List for Rs 1 Crore
 Personal Finance oi-Harshika Yadav By Harshika Yadav 
 Updated: Friday, October 16, 2026, 15:45 [IST]
 Add as a preferred source on Google The Kerala State Lotteries Department is set to conduct the Suvarna Keralam SK-73 lottery draw on Friday, October 16, 2026, with ticket holders awaiting the announcement of the winning numbers. The draw offers a first prize of Rs 1 crore, along with several other cash rewards for winners across different categories. The results are expected to be announced at 3 PM in Thiruvananthapuram.
 Kerala Suvarna Keralam SK-73 Lottery Result Today LIVE on 16 October 2026: Check Winners List for Rs 1 Crore Prize Money
 The draw will take place at Gorky Bhavan, near Bakery Junction, Thiruvananthapuram, according to the department's published schedule. Participants can check their tickets against the official result list once the winning numbers are released. The Kerala Government Gazette should also be consulted for final verification before submitting a prize claim.
 Kerala Suvarna Keralam SK-73 Lottery Prizes
 The Suvarna Keralam weekly lottery offers multiple prize categories, with Rs 1 crore awarded to the first-prize winner. The second prize is Rs 30 lakh, while the third prize is Rs 5 lakh. Ticket holders can also win smaller amounts, along with a consolation prize of Rs 5,000.

 The winning numbers for the first, second and third prizes were awaited at the time of writing. Ticket holders should check the complete results after the draw and ensure that the ticket number and series match the official announcement.
 How to Check Kerala Lottery Result for SK-73
 Once the results are announced, participants can visit the official Kerala State Lotteries Department website to find the winning numbers. They should carefully compare the ticket number, series and draw code with the published list before concluding that a ticket has won a prize.
 Results may also appear on private lottery websites and other online platforms. However, the official department's result notification and the Kerala Government Gazette should remain the primary references for confirming winning tickets.
 Kerala Lottery Prize Claim: Important Points for Winners
 Winners should keep their original tickets safe and in good condition, as the ticket is required for verification during the claim process. They should also check the applicable claim deadline and documentation requirements prescribed by the Kerala State Lotteries Department.
 Before submitting a claim, ticket holders should confirm their winning status through official records and follow the authorised procedure for the relevant prize category. Careful verification of the ticket details and preservation of the original document can help avoid complications during the claim process.
